3. OUR SERVICES

Shubha Sankalpam is an online platform that helps devotees book pujas, homams, sevas and related religious and spiritual services performed at temples or other venues by independent temples, purohits, priests and ritual coordinators ("Service Providers").

  • When you book a puja, the Sankalpam is recited in the name, gotra and details you provide, and the ritual is performed on your behalf by the Service Provider.
  • We coordinate the booking, the performance of the ritual and, where the booked Service includes it, the sharing of photos or a video of the ritual. We aim to share these within about 48 hours of the puja being performed, but timing may vary.
  • Descriptions, images, schedules, temples and prices shown on the Platform are provided in good faith and may be updated at any time without notice. Pujas and packages may be added, changed, paused or removed.
  • Prasadam or other physical items, if offered with a Service, are as described on that Service's page, and delivery times are estimates only.

5. BOOKINGS AND CONFIRMATION

  • A booking is created when you complete the booking steps on the Platform. It is confirmed only after we receive payment, or confirm your booking by another method we offer, and you see a confirmation on the Platform or receive one from us.
  • Pujas are performed on the date shown on the Platform, or on the nearest suitable date notified to you, subject to temple schedules, panchangam and muhurtham, the availability of Service Providers, and circumstances outside our control.
  • If a Service cannot be performed on the booked date, we may reschedule it to another suitable date after informing you. If a suitable date is not possible, our Refund Policy will apply.
  • We may decline or cancel any booking where we reasonably suspect an error, fraud, misuse or a breach of these Terms, in which case we will refund any amount you have paid for that booking.

6. PRICES AND PAYMENTS

  • Payments are made through third-party payment gateways, banks, UPI or other payment service providers. These providers process your payment under their own terms and privacy policies. We do not store your full card details, UPI PIN or banking passwords.
  • You agree to pay using a payment method you are authorised to use. A booking may fail if your payment is declined, reversed or not completed. If money is debited but the booking is not confirmed, please contact us with your transaction details and we will help resolve it.

7. CANCELLATION AND REFUNDS

Variations in rituals may occur between temples, traditions and priests. Your decision to book is made on the basis of your own beliefs.
